Beyblade X UX-11 Starter Impact Drake 9-60LR is a genuine Takara Tomy Beyblade X starter released in Japan on 2024-12-28. This guide describes the store SKU, the manufacturer's listing and the stock parts documented in our research dossier. Availability and local price belong on the product page.

## Design and what is in the box [...] ### What is UX-11?

It is Takara Tomy's Starter release in the Beyblade X line. The stock configuration and package conditions are listed above.

### Does UX-11 include a launcher and stadium?

A compatible launcher is included with this Starter; a Beyblade X stadium is needed separately.

## Sources and safety [...] UX Unique Line shifts more Blade metal outward to emphasize a particular battle characteristic. Impact Drake's thick contact wings and rubber elements are intended to hit hard. The short 9-60 Ratchet and Low Rush bit keep the stock combination low and active for upper-contact attacks. A launcher is included with this starter. A Beyblade X stadium is needed for play. Stock battle type: Attack. Spin: right. Stock Ratchet and Bit notation: 9-60LR.
